newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR rubber offer prices remained unchanged in late trading on Wednesday, with no fresh enquiries heard, traders said.
They said SIR20 was on offer at 49.50 U.S. cents/lb in Medan and at 49.00 cents in Palembang, both unchanged from the opening and Tuesday's close.
"There were no new enquiries or bids today," one trader said. "Consumer demand has been particularly thin, as tyre makers seem to be waiting for prices to decline further."
The trader said foreign dealers had purchased some rubber on Tuesday, but were quiet today.
Traders said the dealers bought June shipment SIR20 at 49.25 cents/lb FOB Medan and at 48.625-49.00 cents FOB Palembang.

"The purchases were made by dealers for the U.S. market," one trader said, adding that details had yet to emerge. "Tyre makers themselves are not in the market, as they are waiting for prices to decline before taking positions."
Another trader said deals were done in Palembang at 48.625 cents/lb for June shipment, and 49.00 cents for July/August.
"The market has been dull, and buyers seem to be well stocked and know they can pressure the market," he said.
